headline: Foodbank Australia Reports 3.6 Million Households Facing Hunger
summary: Foodbank Australia's annual report indicates 3.6 million households are going hungry, representing an increase from the previous year.
why: Food security reports serve as key indicators of cost-of-living pressures and economic hardship among households.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Heightened food insecurity reflects consumer financial distress and lower discretionary spending power.
